dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: So bored... Need someone to play with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Mom and dad don't have time to come home and play with me, so I have to play here all by myself. But it's so boring playing with only one person...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Also, I can't stray too far from home, otherwise mom and dad wouldn't be able to find me when they got back, and then they'd start worrying.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Do you wanna play with me? We can play hide-and-seek, it's really easy, anyone can play it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, I love that game!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Yay! Alright, let the game begin!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Um, but gimme a sec first... I haven't thought where to hide...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: ...Okay, I got it! Hehehe, you'll never find me!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, no hiding and seeking for me today...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay... Guess I'll play alone some more then...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay! Uh, on your marks... get ready... let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not just yet...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Okay, well you do what you gotta do... and when you're ready, let me know!

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: When will Mommy and Daddy get back...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this your home?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Yep! I live here with Mommy and Daddy. But actually, I don't know where they are right now.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But that means that I have to stay nearby. I mean, what if they came back and couldn't find me? They'd be so worried...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your daily life like?

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: There's a man who comes and gives me food sometimes. He says that I should call him Uncle Tian, and that he's a distant relative, and that he knows my mom and dad really well.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: He says mom and dad are busy right now and can't come home, so if there's anything I need, I can just go to him instead.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But when I asked him where mom and dad are, he didn't tell me. So I think he's a bit of a weirdo, too.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: There's also a bunch of Milleliths who come and see me, too. They always bring me lots of tasty snacks. Sometimes I can't manage them all, so they just leave them in the house for me.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But they say that they don't know where mom and dad are, either. It's so strange...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are those two stone tablets...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Oh, those stones are from the Milleliths, too. They said Mommy and Daddy got them to put them up here for them.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But I can't read very well. There's so many words on them that I don't recognize...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But I guess if they're from Mommy and Daddy, they must be really important to them, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Mm, see you. Do come back to play with me again if you have the time!
